verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a reasonable thing to ask of a corporate spend-management platform, so the axis applies. The only AI-related evidence is marketing copy about AI-generated alerts and strategic insights on channel spend. That is an adjacent analytics feature, not an assistant users can hand tasks to. The API, llms.txt and Markdown docs are developer and agent-integration building blocks, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
